61: async function request<T>(
62:   path: string,
63:   options: RequestInit = {}
64: ): Promise<T> {
65:   const token = getAccessToken();
66:   const headers: Record<string, string> = {
67:     ...(options.headers as Record<string, string>),
68:   };
69:   if (token) {
70:     headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${token}`;
71:   }
72: 
73:   const isFormData = options.body instanceof FormData;
74:   if (!isFormData && !headers["Content-Type"]) {
75:     headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
76:   }
77: 
78:   let response = await fetch(path, { ...options, headers });
79: 
80:   if (response.status === 401) {
81:     const refresh = getRefreshToken();
82:     if (refresh) {
83:       try {
84:         const refreshResponse = await fetch("/api/auth/refresh", {
85:           method: "POST",
86:           headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
87:           body: JSON.stringify({ refresh_token: refresh }),
88:         });
89:         if (refreshResponse.ok) {
90:           const tokens: AccessTokenResponse = await refreshResponse.json();
91:           setTokens(tokens.access_token, refresh);
92:           headers["Authorization"] = `Bearer ${tokens.access_token}`;
93:           response = await fetch(path, { ...options, headers });
94:         } else {
95:           clearTokens();
96:           window.location.href = "/login";
97:           throw new ApiError(401, null);
98:         }
99:       } catch {
100:         clearTokens();
101:         window.location.href = "/login";
102:         throw new ApiError(401, null);
103:       }
104:     }
105:   }
106: 
107:   if (!response.ok) {
108:     const body = await response.json().catch(() => null);
109:     throw new ApiError(response.status, body);
110:   }
111: 
112:   return response.json();
113: }
